reset_sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
check_email: Check your email and tap the confirmation link, then sign in here.
have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
i_am_driver: I'm a driver with an invite code
invite_ready: Give this code to your driver. It works once and expires in 7 days.
confirm_remove: Remove this driver's access now? Their documents stay with the company.
driver_home_note: You're connected to your company. Sending documents comes in the next step.
owner_home_note: Documents and papers come in the next steps.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
invite_link_ready: Send this link to your driver (WhatsApp, text or email). It works once and expires in 7 days. The code above is for typing in by hand.
share_text: Join {company} on TruckDocs. Tap the link to create your account:
invited_note: You have been invited to join a company. Create your account (or sign in) and you will join with one tap.
confirm_retire: Delete this from your list? Papers already sent with this number are kept in your records.
unit_exists: That number is already in your list. It is now selected above.
unit_retired: Deleted from your list. Papers already sent with it are kept.
tagline: Truck papers, fuel receipts and load documents, safe in one place.
tagline_signup: Free for drivers. Set up your company in under a minute.
tagline_forgot: We'll email you a link to set a new password.
invite_help: Send a link by WhatsApp or text. Your driver taps it and joins your company.
no_trucks_driver: Your owner hasn’t added trucks or trailers yet. You can still send papers.
capture_help: Take a clear photo of the paper, flat and in good light. For several pages, add each page.
finish_help: This paper didn’t finish sending. Take the photo again and tap Send.
photo_check: Check the photo is sharp and readable. If not, remove it and take it again.
sent_ok: ✓ Sent. Your owner can see it now.
not_confirmed: The server did not confirm this paper. It is kept as “Not sent yet” — tap Send again.
send_failed_kept: Not sent yet. Your photos are still here — check your signal and tap Send again.
file_too_big: This file is too big (over 15 MB). Try fewer pages or a smaller file.
pdf_alone: A PDF must be sent on its own. Remove the photos first, or send the PDF as a separate paper.
too_many_pages: Up to 15 pages per paper. Send the rest as a new paper.
pdf_failed: Could not join the pages into one PDF. Check your internet and try again.
litres_bad: Litres must be a number, like 450.
open_failed: Could not open this file. Check your internet and try again.
confirm_trash: Move this paper to trash? Nothing is erased. You can restore it from the trash.
trash_help: Papers in the trash are kept, never erased. Tap Restore to bring one back.
paper_trashed: Moved to trash. You can restore it from the trash.
